description: This file defines the Configuration class for AWS SDK's DefaultsMode, managing configuration settings such as mode, retry mode, regional endpoints, and timeouts, with logic to load and override default settings based on mode.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Class managing AWS SDK default configuration modes, including validation, loading defaults, and providing accessors for configuration properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes configuration based on mode, loading defaults and applying overrides or modifications.

methods.name: getStsRegionalEndpoints
methods.description: Returns the STS regional endpoints setting.

methods.name: getS3UsEast1RegionalEndpoints
methods.description: Returns the S3 US East 1 regional endpoints setting.

methods.name: getConnectTimeoutInMillis
methods.description: Returns the connection timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: getHttpRequestTimeoutInMillis
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
